status: Provisional research, not implemented V2 rules or launch prices
scope: Read-only source/receipt research and hypothetical deterministic arithmetic. No production game, contracts, token settings, wallets or deployments changed.
confirmedOwnerDirections: Earned NFT purse tokens remain withdrawable by the owner after biological death.
Careful repeat play is welcome; idle roosters do not age or produce.
Four total growing slots, with a tree consuming one slot.
Crop maturation tiers of three, six and eight game-growth days.
Flowers, strawberries and blueberries have a single harvest and clear their slot.
Grapes and apples mature at eight growth days, regrow every two days and yield six times in total.
The wood tree matures at six growth days, regrows every two days and yields ten wood in total.
Craft wood quantities are spoon3, toy boat6, birdhouse8 and large chest10.
Sellable products must be produced by the NPC rather than chosen as free deliveries.
The token NFT mint price is fixed for a season; native gas/processing fees remain separate from play-token accounting.
proposedAssumptionsNotYetOwnerApproved: One bed is planted per main undertaking; one main harvest round may collect all ready slots.
A nontradeable garden well supplies a single watering round for up to four slots, separate from drinking bottles.
A natural breakfast routine groups actual food and drink while preserving both item and energy costs.
Ready produce waits, and regrowth begins after pickup; the initial yield counts toward six or ten.
All four crafts initially use one main undertaking; no multi-day work-in-progress system is assumed.
Relative base-point prices and the pressure index are research candidates, not accepted token denomination or financial promises.

studies.scope: 100-day constructed care schedules, including a retained tight/failing naive stress policy. Treatment stock and deterministic policy are assumptions, not actual Jev outcomes.
Time/work-aware gross base points and optional paid-seed illustrations. Costs, batching and rounding assumptions are explicit.
Earliest isolated harvest/craft schedules and four-slot allocation comparisons.
Exhaustive best-harvest-count schedules inside a simplified monoculture model over30/60/90 game days. Excludes care costs, seed costs, mixed crops, crafting, mortality, token prices and AI.
Optimistic mechanism witnesses comparing supply pressure, burns and producer expansion; not calibrated crop returns or population forecasts.
Three historical testnet processing fees versus relay execution-gas components; no mainnet or USD valuation. Kept separate from token economics.
